name: narrow-top1
description: Short windows and a single hit. Rerank off. A long glossary note can take the only slot.

name: wide-top4
description: Long windows pack each glossary note into the same hit as the procedure note, and the result list is four deep. Rerank off.

name: rerank-top1
description: Same short windows as narrow-top1. Eight candidates are reordered by term density, then cut to one hit. Local stand-in for a reranker, not a hosted cross-encoder.
